title: Bounded-index decoding
statement: For every natural number $n$, every index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and every bit string $x$, reading the unary code of $i$—$i$ ones followed by a zero—then $x$, with the range-checked unary index reader of bound $n$, succeeds and returns $(i,x)$.
replaced:
For a bound $n$, an index $i < n$, and any bit string $x$: the range-checked
unary reader with bound $n$, applied to the self-delimiting unary code of $i$
($i$ ones followed by a zero) concatenated with $x$, succeeds and returns
$(i, x)$.
